findings.current: “I put it off because it could wait. You were there even if I wasn’t.”
findings.defect: The draft says the emergency response itself could wait, but Taekyung says he delegated the job because the Skeleton King could handle it in his place.
findings.rationale: The following explanation confirms that Taekyung assessed the Gate and sent the Skeleton King instead of going himself; he did not postpone the emergency response.
findings.replacement: “I delegated it because I could. Even if I wasn’t there, they still had you.”
findings.source: “미룰 만하니까 미루지. 내가 없어도 너 있잖아.”

findings.current: He had possessed powerful abilities even back when he was called a Warlord, but after his battle with the Lich, he had evolved into an even more powerful being.
findings.defect: The draft drops the source’s explicit “Arch” classification from “Arch Lich.”
findings.rationale: 아크 리치 specifies an Arch Lich, not merely a Lich.
findings.replacement: He had possessed powerful abilities even back when he was called a Warlord, but after his battle with the Arch Lich, he had evolved into an even more powerful being.
findings.source: 아크 리치와의 전투를 통해 더욱 강력한 존재로 거듭났다.

findings.current: What the hell was a noble grinding session?
findings.defect: The draft turns Taekyung’s profane, contemptuous dismissal into a genuine-sounding question.
findings.rationale: 같은 소리 하고 자빠졌네 rejects and mocks the preceding phrase rather than asking what it means.
findings.replacement: A noble grinding session, my ass.
findings.source: 존귀한 부비부비 같은 소리 하고 자빠졌네.

findings.current: I didn’t need to look to know what it was.
findings.defect: The meaning is retained, but the draft omits the deliberate “hologram” variation on the familiar expression 안 봐도 비디오, losing the source’s joke.
findings.rationale: 홀로그램 is an intentional technological update to the idiom and supplies the sentence’s humor.
findings.replacement: I didn’t need to look to know why. The answer might as well have been projected as a hologram.

summary: One major causal error, one omitted monster classification, and two localized humor defects.
